OK no, you can't do this.
1. You are nowhere near a uranium zone, and plutonium is not viable as fissile material for a nuclear bomb unless if it is plutonium 239. In fact, you actually need uranium to make any kind of plutonium - it is an artificial element that is created when the nucleus of a uranium atom gains more neutrons.
2. That is not how a nuclear bomb works. We expect at least a degree of plausibility or realism in Erene, and this blueprint meets neither of those points. TR bombs are literally impossible.
3. You do not meet the GDP requirement to make nuclear technology. You need $3 trillion to have access to that kind of tech and even then you only meet half of the requirements since you don't have access to uranium.
